clauses.3.1: Accidental damage. We repair or replace a covered device damaged by a sudden and unexpected accident, up to USD 1,500 per device. You pay USD 75 for each claim.
clauses.4.1: Theft. Theft is covered only if the device was locked away or attached to you at the time. Devices left unattended in a public place are not covered.
clauses.5.1: Exclusions. We do not cover cosmetic damage, wear and tear, or damage caused by deliberate acts.
